atq.text: Argoth is a forested island rich in natural wealth, and it is drawn into the Brothers' War when Gix lures both Urza and Mishra there, starting the Battle at Argoth.
Titania tries to negotiate with both brothers, but they will not leave, so she leads the offensive against both armies and becomes an avatar of Gaea.
At the last battle Ashnod passes the Sylex to Tawnos, Urza finds Mishra corrupted by Phyrexian influence, and the Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth, igniting Urza's planeswalker spark.
After the destruction Gaea instills a portion of her power into vengeful followers.

bro.text: In The Brothers' War, Argoth is a pristine island whose discovery by Harbin sends Urza's and Mishra's armies in to deplete its forests, until the war comes down to who can plunder it faster.
Gix drives the artifact creatures in both armies mad, Titania and the Colossus of Sardia fight and both die, and Ashnod hands the Golgothian Sylex to Tawnos, who brings it to Urza.
Mishra taunts Urza's aging, Urza sees his brother's machine parts, and Urza activates the Sylex, which nearly wipes Argoth from the map and throws Dominaria into an Ice Age.

In another telling, Teferi finds the battle moments before the detonation and tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker, while the few surviving elves eke out an existence until migrating to Fyndhorn centuries later.
